description_en: Queries the details of a group
description_zh: 调用该接口查询分组详情
name: QueryDeviceGroupInfo

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html operation to query the group ID (GroupId)
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID，分组的全局唯一标识符。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html接口查询分组ID（**GroupId**）
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The group type.

Only LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC is supported, which indicates a dynamic group. If you do not specify this parameter, the group is a static group by default
parameters.help_zh:
分组类型。

目前仅支持传入LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC，表示动态分组。不传入时，默认为静态分组
parameters.name: group_type

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The detailed information about the group returned if the call was successful. The following parameters are included
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的分组详细信息数据，包含以下参数

DynamicGroupExpression.description_en: The dynamic group rule. This parameter is returned only for dynamic groups
DynamicGroupExpression.description_zh: 动态分组规则，仅动态分组返回该参数信息

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
